description: This file contains an Android Activity named Bouncer1 that displays an animated bitmap that moves vertically in a bouncing pattern, along with an inner View class MyView responsible for rendering the bitmap and handling its animation.

classes.name: Bouncer1
classes.description: Main activity that sets the content view.

classes.name: Bouncer1.MyView
classes.description: Custom View that displays and animates a bitmap with vertical bouncing motion.

methods.name: Bouncer1.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: MyView.setupShape
methods.description: Loads the bitmap resource and initializes shape dimensions.

methods.name: MyView.setShapeX
methods.description: Sets the X position of the shape and updates invalidated region.

methods.name: MyView.setShapeY
methods.description: Sets the Y position of the shape and updates invalidated region.

methods.name: MyView.startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts an infinite bounce animation for the shape.

methods.name: MyView.getValueAnimator
methods.description: Generates a ValueAnimator that updates the Y position based on the animation fraction.
